prompt: What should the volunteer use to serve the remaining diners?
promptZh: 志工應該用什麼供餐給剩下的用餐者？

options.text: A stack of plates from the side table
options.zh: 從旁桌拿來的一疊盤子
options.whyZh: 旁桌那個寫十二的架子只放空盤，不是額外的食物。

options.text: The four scoops and some bake from the warming shelf
options.zh: 手邊的四勺，再加保溫層架上的一些料理
options.whyZh: 六人還在等，四勺不夠；協調員說用保溫架小烤盤的料理補足。

options.text: Just the four scoops, split into six full servings
options.zh: 只用四勺，分成六份完整份量
options.whyZh: 一滿勺才算一份，四勺不能變六份完整份量。

options.text: Twelve portions already waiting beside the board
options.zh: 板子旁已備好的十二份
options.whyZh: 對話的十二是空盤數，不是十二份食物。

explanationZh: 六人還在等，四勺不夠；協調員說用保溫架小烤盤的料理補足。
evidence: Count portions, not plates. A full scoop is one portion. Those split servings were still one scoop each. | The side table has a rack marked twelve. Can we count that? Six late diners are waiting, and there are only four scoops here. | That rack has twelve empty plates, not food. Use the bake from the small pan on the warming shelf to make up the difference.

vocabulary.note: 此處是補足四勺到六份的差額。
